operating_notes.text: Fire at factory on 7 February 2026 destroyed PPE and inventory; total loss ₹10.63 Cr, insurance claim of ₹18.02 Cr lodged, ₹1.70 Cr received.
Silver hedging resulted in a ₹9.51 Cr loss in Q4FY26.
Company divested its entire stake in wholly owned subsidiary Modison Hitech Private Limited effective June 9, 2025.
Developed Silver-Tungsten Carbide technology electrical contacts for railway signalling relays with an estimated annual domestic market opportunity of ₹2,250 crore.
